#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ull = unsigned long long;
int mod_value;

int fast_pow(int x, int n) {
    int res = 1;
    while (n) {
        if (n & 1) res = (long long)res * x % mod_value;
        x = (long long)x * x % mod_value;
        n >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

const int MAXN = 300000 + 5;
ull dp[27][MAXN];
int fact[MAXN], invfact[MAXN];

int P(int n, int m) {
    return (long long)fact[n] * invfact[n - m] % mod_value;
}

int main() {
    int n, K;
    scanf("%d%d%d", &n, &K, &mod_value);

    if (n & 1) {
        printf("%d\n", fast_pow(K, n));
        return 0;
    }

    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
        fact[i] = (long long)fact[i - 1] * i % mod_value;

    invfact[n] = fast_pow(fact[n], mod_value - 2);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i)
        invfact[i] = (long long)invfact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod_value;

    dp[0][0] = 1;

    for (int k = 0; k < K; ++k) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            if ((i & n) != i) continue;

            ull total = 0;
            int cnt = 0;
            int hb = (1 << (31 - __builtin_clz(i)));

            for (int j = i - hb; j >= 0; j = (j - 1) & i) {
                int jj = j + hb;
                total += dp[k][i ^ jj] * invfact[jj];
                if (cnt++ == 17) {
                    total %= mod_value;
                    cnt = 0;
                }
                if (j == 0) break;
            }

            dp[k + 1][i] = total % mod_value;
        }
    }

    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= K; ++i)
        (ans += 1LL * fact[n] * dp[i][n] % mod_value * P(K, i) % mod_value) %= mod_value;

    printf("%d\n", (fast_pow(K, n) + mod_value - ans) % mod_value);
    return 0;
}
